claim_boundary: No conservation or exchange law is derived here. This artifact records the available routes and required proof obligations.

routes.proof_obligation: Derive each active T^{mu nu}, sum sectors, and show divergence vanishes under the chosen EOM.

routes.proof_obligation: Define exchange currents, signs, source/sink sectors, and show total exchange sums to zero.
